name: smartsupp-insights
description: Turn Smartsupp chats into knowledge-gap articles for the AI chatbot, CX scores, topic clusters, contradictions, feedback drafts, product info gaps and a weekly pulse. Requires the Smartsupp MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Knowledge-gap articles, CX scores and insights from Smartsupp chats
interface.longDescription: Reads closed Smartsupp conversations through the Smartsupp MCP server (read tools only), redacts personal data, and drafts knowledge-gap articles to paste into the Smartsupp AI chatbot's knowledge, plus CX scores, topics, contradictions, feedback drafts, product info gaps and a weekly pulse.
defaultPrompt: Find knowledge gaps in last week's Smartsupp chats.
Run the weekly pulse for my Smartsupp chats.
